service.title: Service Description & Broker Role
service.body: Y7 Consulting Inc (DBA Y7 Logistics), USDOT #4427359, MC #1741537, acts as a licensed property broker, not a motor carrier. We arrange vehicle transportation with licensed, insured motor carriers on your behalf. We do not own or operate trucks, and transportation is performed solely by independent carrier companies. Our role is to secure reliable transport, coordinate dispatch, and facilitate communication between you and the assigned carrier.

fees.title: Service Fee Schedule
fees.body:
Y7 Consulting Inc ("Y7 Logistics") charges a dispatch fee for brokerage services:

• Standard (COD): $50.00 — Y7 arranges carrier transport. Customer pays the carrier directly upon delivery after vehicle inspection.
• Full Service: $65.00 + carrier transport cost — Y7 arranges carrier transport AND handles carrier payment on Customer's behalf.

The dispatch fee covers carrier sourcing, quote negotiation, dispatch coordination, shipment monitoring, and customer support throughout the transport process.

bol.title: Vehicle Inspection & Bill of Lading (BOL)
bol.body: Upon delivery, you or your authorized representative MUST inspect the vehicle together with the carrier driver and sign the Bill of Lading (BOL). The BOL documents vehicle condition at both pickup and delivery. By signing the BOL at delivery without noting damage, you acknowledge the vehicle was received in the condition described. Any damage claims filed after signing a clean BOL are the recipient's sole responsibility. You have the right to note any new damage on the BOL before signing. If the carrier refuses to allow inspection, do not sign and contact Y7 immediately.

payment.title: Payment Terms
payment.body:
Standard (COD) Orders:
• Dispatch fee ($50.00) is charged via credit/debit card at the time of order confirmation.
• Carrier transport cost is paid by Customer directly to the carrier driver upon delivery, after vehicle inspection. Accepted payment methods vary by carrier (typically cash, cashier's check, or money order).

Full Service Orders:
• Total amount (carrier transport cost + $65.00 dispatch fee) is charged via credit/debit card at the time of order confirmation.
• Y7 pays the carrier on Customer's behalf after successful delivery confirmation.

If COD is selected, failure to pay the carrier at delivery may result in the carrier retaining possession of the vehicle, daily storage fees, and/or a lien on the vehicle. Y7 Consulting Inc is not responsible for carrier-imposed fees resulting from non-payment at delivery.

insurance.title: Insurance & Claims
insurance.body: All carriers in our network maintain minimum $100,000 cargo insurance per FMCSA requirements, with most carrying $250,000 or more. We verify active insurance coverage before assigning any carrier to your load. In the event of damage, claims must be filed within 24 hours of delivery with photographs of the damage and a copy of the BOL noting the damage. Y7 Consulting Inc will assist you in filing the claim with the carrier's insurance, but as a broker, we bear no direct cargo liability. Claims are settled between you and the carrier's insurance provider. Customers may purchase additional coverage through third-party transport insurance providers. Theft, Fire & Total Loss: In the event of vehicle theft, fire, or total loss during transport, the carrier's cargo insurance applies up to the policy limit. Customer should immediately file a police report (in case of theft) and contact Y7 Logistics. Y7 will provide the carrier's insurance information and assist in filing the claim. Vehicle valuation for total loss is determined by the carrier's insurance provider based on actual cash value at the time of loss.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.body:
Customer may cancel a confirmed order subject to the following refund policy:

• Cancellation within 24 hours of payment AND before a carrier has been assigned: Full refund of all amounts paid.
• Cancellation after 24 hours OR after a carrier has been assigned: Refund minus a $10.00 administrative fee.
• For Full Service orders: Payment processing fees (approximately 2.9% + $0.30) are non-refundable and will be deducted from any refund amount.
• For Standard (COD) orders: Y7 absorbs payment processing fees — Customer receives the full refund amount as stated above.

Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days to the original payment method.

No-show at pickup: if the vehicle is not available for pickup at the scheduled time and location, and no prior rescheduling was arranged, the dispatch fee is non-refundable and additional carrier charges may apply.

Y7 reserves the right to issue a full refund at its discretion for customer service purposes. To cancel or reschedule, contact us at info@y7agency.com as early as possible.

customer.title: Customer Obligations
customer.body: You agree to: (1) provide accurate vehicle information including VIN, condition, and operability status; (2) ensure the vehicle is accessible for pickup at the scheduled time and location; (3) inspect the vehicle at both pickup and delivery and sign the Bill of Lading; (4) disclose any modifications or non-running condition; (5) remove all personal belongings before pickup; (6) pay the agreed transport fee per the payment terms. Inoperable vehicles (non-running, non-steering, non-braking) require special equipment and may incur additional fees of $100-$300. You must accurately disclose vehicle condition — failure to do so may result in additional charges at pickup. Personal Items: Y7 Logistics and the assigned carrier are NOT liable for any personal items left in the vehicle during transport. Any personal items remaining in the vehicle are transported at the customer's own risk and are not covered by carrier cargo insurance.

delays.title: Estimated Dates & Delays
delays.body: All pickup and delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Actual transit times depend on distance, carrier availability, weather, road conditions, and other factors. Typical transit: 1-3 days for routes under 500 miles, 3-7 days for cross-country. Neither Y7 Consulting Inc nor the assigned carrier shall be liable for delays caused by weather events, natural disasters, government actions, road closures, mechanical breakdowns, traffic, or other circumstances beyond reasonable control (force majeure). Y7 will communicate proactively if significant delays occur.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability & Dispute Resolution
liability.body:
Y7 Consulting Inc acts solely as a licensed property broker (FMCSA MC #1741537, USDOT #4427359). Y7 does NOT operate as a motor carrier and does NOT transport vehicles.

Y7's total liability for any claim arising from brokerage services is limited to the dispatch fee paid for the specific shipment in question.

Y7 is NOT liable for:
• Vehicle damage during transport (carrier's insurance applies)
• Carrier delays or missed pickup/delivery windows
• Acts of God, weather events, or road conditions
• Loss of personal items left in the vehicle

Carrier liability is governed by the carrier's own insurance and the Bill of Lading (BOL) signed at pickup. Customer should inspect the vehicle upon delivery and note any damage on the BOL before signing.

Any dispute arising from this agreement shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association, conducted in Suffolk County, Massachusetts. This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. This limitation applies to the fullest extent permitted by law.
